name: Xanthule Ascension Flight Helmet
description: Adapted by Syang Fabrication to meet the unique requirements of the Human physique, the Xanthule helmet faithfully recreates the bold silhouette preferred by Xi'an. When paired with the Xanthule suit, it creates a distinct and eye-catching look. This special IAE 2953 edition is decorated with a copper and white pattern inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.
